_readme: Business details. Edit anything here and the whole site updates. Times are 24-hour, local Halifax time.
name: Tasty Pizza
tagline: Dartmouth's pizza shop for over 20 years
owner: Owned and operated by the Patel family
claim: Halifax's official food, made on Main Street.
blurb: Family-run on Main Street in Dartmouth. Dough and pizza sauce made fresh every day, the best donair in town, and a kitchen that's still on at 1am Friday and Saturday.
_hoursReadme: 24-hour clock. Closing times past midnight use 24+ (e.g. 26 = 2am next day). Set 'closed': true for a day off.
_taxReadme: Nova Scotia HST. Dropped from 15% to 14% on 1 April 2025.

delivery.note: Delivery on orders over $10 after 2pm in our local area.

Prices and store hours are subject to change without notice.
_liveReadme: Leave this false while the site is only a preview on github.io. It tells Google not to index the preview, so it can never compete with the real tastypizza.ca in search. Set it to true on the day the site goes live on tastypizza.ca.

seo.title: Tasty Pizza — Donairs, Pizza & Garlic Fingers in Dartmouth, NS
seo.description: Dartmouth's donair and pizza shop on Main Street. Fresh dough daily, garlic fingers, subs and seafood. Open 7 days, Friday till 1am. Call 902-435-5700.
